title: POTATO BALLS
instructions: Pare and boil dry some potatoes. Then put them into a hot pan and mash with a lump of butter,  salt and pepper. Beat this well, and make into small flat cakes. Dip them into egg and sprinkle with bread crumbs. Fry a nice brown.

Take six or eight partridges, or small quails, brown them in a small pan with lard and a light sprinkling of flour. Add three tablespoonfuls of raw tomatoes, half a cupful of meat juice,  onion,  salt and pepper. Let them simmer an hour, covered. Baste them from time to time with the gravy. Serve with hot rice. "UNCLE JOHN," Chef for Mr. Le Garee, of South Carolina.
